items.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
items.content_html:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day five (part two) and I visit the capital of Switzerland ‘Bern’, I check out the Zytglogge clock tower in the medieval city center, the Bern Bear Park and the area around it including some wonderful bridges and the fresh crisp water of the River Aare – enjoy the photos! 🙂

items.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Five – Fribourg (Inc. 4K Video)
items.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
items.content_html:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day five and I travel to the Swiss French town of Fribourg, originally I had planned to visit Bern for this day but once on the train I saw a picture of Berne Bridge in Fribourg and decided to transfer from Bern railway station to Fribourg to go check it out! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

items.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Four – Lugano (Inc. 4K Video)
items.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
items.content_html:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day four and today the weather takes a turn for the worst! after a rainy nights camping I awake to more rain in Interlaken and decide that as I’ve got the Swiss Travel Pass I would travel quite a distance to the Italian Swiss town of Lugano – the climate there is more of a sunny one for sure!

It takes an average of 4h 42m to travel from Interlaken West to Lugano by train, over a distance of around 70 miles (113 km) so I brought my lunch on the train with me! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

items.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Three – Lucerne (Inc. 4K Video)
items.summary: Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of…
items.content_html:
Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day three and I travel to the Swiss central city of Lucerne (or Luzern) where I admire the handy work of the 14th century Chapel Bridge, explore the old town and walk the old fortifications, this is my third visit to the city and it still has it’s charms! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

items.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Two – The Schilthorn, Piz Gloria, 007 & Lauterbrunnen (Inc. 4K Video)
items.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
items.content_html:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day two and as the weather is holding up nicely I decide to tackle my next big destination today – the summit of the Schilthorn! made famous for being the film location for the iconic Bond movie “On Her Majesty’s Secret Service” which was released in 1969 and has very interesting story behind how it happened.

To reach the Schilthorn and Piz Gloria (the 360-degree revolving restaurant that sits on top of the summit) I took a train from Interlaken to Stechelberg then took a series of five cable cars to reach the summit, the whole journey was full of eye watering scenery! enjoy the photos! 🙂

items.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day One – Zermatt & The Matterhorn (Inc. 4K Video)
items.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
items.content_html:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day one (though in reality it’s day two after the first whole day of travelling!) and even though I’m extremely tired from the day before, I’m up super early after my first night camping into a seven day stay at Camping Hobby in Interlaken.

The Swiss weather report for cloud cover and blue skies in Zermatt look good and I have a 8 day Swiss Travel Pass (unlimited access on the network of Swiss Travel System for 8 days) so I head off to my first destination of Zermatt, then use the famous Gornegrat Railway to reach the summit of Gornegrat and check out the gorgeous views of the Matterhorn – enjoy the photos! 🙂
